note: FTexture2DResource::LoadMipData - THE cause of the corrupt textures. Retail reads every streamed mip level from the single Filename the resource was built with (the TextureFileCacheName .tfc for streaming textures) and has no fallback, so a level the cook left inline in the package cannot be streamed: its BulkDataOffsetInFile is a package offset and the read lands on unrelated bytes. Our body already matched retail line for line; the divergence was that nothing kept the inline run resident, so 1779 of 3260 streamed levels in L_Pub_Day_P were filled with garbage. Fixed in UTexture2D::CreateResource + FStreamingManagerTexture (MinResidentMipCount). Our tree also carries a reference-only MipMap.Data.IsBulkDataLoaded() branch retail does not have; the census shows it fires 0 times

FTexture2DResource::GetData - identical to ours: SrcPitch = BlockBytes * ((SizeX+BlockSizeX-1)/BlockSizeX); if SrcPitch == DestPitch a single memcpy of BlockBytes*NumColumns*NumRows, otherwise row by row with Min(SrcPitch,DestPitch) for NumRows rows. The 552 pitch mismatches the census reports in L_Pub_Day_P are all 1x1/2x2/2x1 levels of uncompressed formats where D3D9 pads the lock pitch to 4 bytes, and retail copies them the same way. Not the defect

FD3D9DynamicRHI::CreateTexture2D - identical to ours. TexCreate_SRGB = 1, TexCreate_ResolveTargetable = 2, TexCreate_DepthStencil = 4, TexCreate_Dynamic = 0x40; managed pool iff (Flags & 6) == 0; VERIFYD3D9CREATETEXTURERESULT with the same arguments; D3D9TextureAllocated only for non-target textures
FD3D9DynamicRHI::LockTexture2D - identical to ours: one LockRect on the mip, DestStride = LockedRect.Pitch, returns pBits
FD3D9DynamicRHI::UnlockTexture2D - identical to ours, a single UnlockRect

FD3D9DynamicRHI::CopyMipToMipAsync - identical to ours: lock source read-only, lock destination for write, memcpy Size bytes, unlock both. Retail has no check(SrcStride == DestStride); ours does and it never fires (44312 shared levels copied in a pub run)

FAsyncIOSystemBase::FulfillCompressedRead - matches ours structurally (8-byte header, TotalChunkCount = (UncompressedSize+ChunkSize-1)/ChunkSize + 1, chunk table, double-buffered reads with Offset = INDEX_NONE, FAsyncTask<FAsyncUncompress>). Retail decompresses with lzopro_lzo1x_decompress_safe for COMPRESS_LZO and zlib uncompress for COMPRESS_ZLIB; our lzokay path decodes the real Textures.tfc chunks to the exact expected sizes (build/agentAR_lzotest.cpp). Eliminated as a cause: -disstreamsync bypassed this whole path with a synchronous FArchive read and the corruption was identical

UTexture2D::PostLoad - MipTailBaseIdx = Max(0, Mips.Num()-1) for non-template objects, then Super::PostLoad. Ours matches; the census confirms MipTailBaseIdx == Mips.Num()-1 on every cooked texture (0 with no mip tail), so NumMipTailLevels is always 1 and was never the floor that mattered

UTexture2D::Serialize - does not touch MinResidentMipCount (@368), so the member is reflected-only in retail too and the cooked packages leave it at 0. CreateResource now derives it from the bulk-data flags (DISHONORED(written))
